metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: If you loved the sharp teen wit and iconic fashion of Clueless, this high school comedy classic is the ultimate follow-up.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A modern, highly witty teen comedy that mirrors the smart, literary adaptation style of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Captures the same bright, bubbly, and deceptively smart protagonist energy found in Clueless.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: Like 10 Things I Hate About You, this is a hilarious, modern teen Shakespeare adaptation full of physical comedy.

metas.name: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
metas.description: A vibrant, stylish, and delightfully quirky 90s comedy that fans of Clueless will adore.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A highly entertaining, romantic fantasy adventure that perfectly fits your taste for magical worlds like Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: The quintessential cozy fantasy-adventure film filled with clever humor, romance, and charm.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A heartwarming, cozy romantic comedy with a fantasy time-travel twist that brings the ultimate feel-good vibes.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A hilarious and sweet blend of fairytale magic and real-world comedy, echoing the lighthearted tone of Practical Magic.

metas.name: Emma.
metas.description: A visually stunning and witty Jane Austen adaptation, which shares its source material directly with Clueless.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A high-concept, video game-inspired action comedy that delivers the same level of self-aware, chaotic fun as Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: The perfect action-adventure-romance cocktail with plenty of comedy, matching the lighthearted monster-hunting energy of D&D and Anaconda.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: An incredibly charming, post-apocalyptic creature adventure with great CGI, heart, and humor.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Features the exact same colorful visual style, classic pop soundtrack, and ensemble action comedy of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
metas.description: A high-octane fantasy adventure filled with incredible action, unforgettable characters, and a massive dose of humor.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A highly comedic, heart-filled superhero movie about a kid in an adult hero's body, echoing the body-swap humor of Jumanji.

metas.name: Night at the Museum
metas.description: A magical, family-friendly fantasy adventure full of historical comedy, fitting perfectly alongside Jumanji.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: If you are anticipating Wake Up Dead Man, this brilliant, star-studded cozy mystery comedy is a must-watch.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: The vibrant, sun-drenched sequel to Knives Out that dials up the comedy, visual flair, and puzzle-box plotting.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Written and directed by Shane Black, this is the direct spiritual predecessor to the hilarious buddy-cop dynamics of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: An incredibly fast-paced, laugh-out-loud mystery-comedy that matches the energetic, chaotic vibes of Jumanji and The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A colorful, quirky, and incredibly fun heist comedy with a stellar ensemble cast.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A masterclass in buddy-cop action-comedy. It delivers high-energy thrillers alongside relentless, brilliant humor.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: A hilariously self-aware buddy-cop action-comedy that matches the sharp-tongued humor of Thor: Ragnarok and The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Borat: Cultural Learnings of America for Make Benefit Glorious Nation of Kazakhstan
metas.description: The quintessential mockumentary from Sacha Baron Cohen, featuring the same extreme, boundary-pushing comedy style of Brüno.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: Jim Carrey's high-energy, cartoonish masterpiece. A perfect match for fans of Ace Ventura: Pet Detective.

metas.name: Liar Liar
metas.description: Another legendary Jim Carrey physical comedy that mixes great physical gags with a sweet, feel-good heart.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: A whimsical, stylish, and fast-paced comedy-adventure that offers the same color-saturated aesthetic and quirkiness as Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A brilliantly funny mockumentary about vampire roommates that delivers the same dry, irreverent comedy of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever, highly original sci-fi romantic comedy that is incredibly easy to watch, funny, and deeply comforting.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A fast-paced, stylized, comic-book action-romance with spectacular visuals and video game energy.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: An extraordinarily funny, highly energetic, and visually stunning animated adventure that is pure feel-good entertainment.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A colorful, neon-lit, high-octane action comedy with an eccentric cast of characters, hitting the sweet spot of your action-comedy list.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: Combines stylish, high-energy action with a fun, comic-book-inspired sense of humor.

metas.name: Rye Lane
metas.description: A vibrant, visually inventive, and genuinely heartwarming modern rom-com that shares the breezy romance of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A delightfully silly romantic adventure comedy set in a jungle, capturing the exact fun flavor of Jumanji.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: A highly quotable, colorful teen comedy with great energy and competitive spirit that pairs perfectly with Clueless.

metas.name: Can't Hardly Wait
metas.description: The ultimate 90s high school party ensemble film, loaded with classic music and nostalgic comfort vibes.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: A whimsical, beautifully shot feel-good romantic comedy that matches the cozy, artistic eccentricities of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: The Heat
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud female buddy-cop comedy that highlights hilarious chemistry and chaotic action.
